name: Bai Xiaotong
source:
[b]"It's not like I made this specially for you! I...I just needed to use up the ingredients that were about to expire in the fridge!"[/b]

Ethnicity: Norwegian-Bai

2nd Year in Technical Secondary School, Major in Computer Science.
Lives next door to Zhong Guolong and is an avid gamer.
Helps out at her grandparents' small convenience store downstairs.
Constantly baffled by her childhood friend's eccentric behaviors.
Pretends not to know him at school because of her mixed-race appearance.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3910860/Chinese_Black_Dragon_Legend]Steam[/url]]
